featured_reviews.name: Sarah Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Jaffer Bhai’s Delhi Darbar Catering Service (Dongri/Sandhurst Road branch) with my mother on the first day of Ramadan to book their services, as they hold a monopoly at Medallion Hall. We have a Haldi function on the third day of Eid, so we were already short on time and had no other options due to this monopoly system.
As soon as we arrived, the manager made a rude comment to his colleagues saying, “Agae Ramadan me uth kar,” which was completely unprofessional and disrespectful. We chose to ignore it and continued politely, asking for the food prices since we genuinely liked the Medallion Hall banquet for our small function.
When I requested a pen and paper to note down the prices, he again reacted rudely. While stepping out, he commented sarcastically, “Ab pen aur paper chahiye.” This kind of behavior toward customers is unacceptable. We were not asking for free food! we were there to book and pay for your “unprofessional” service.
If you do not have the time or basic courtesy to attend to customers properly, then perhaps reconsider holding monopolies in banquet halls just to increase business. Customers deserve respect.
Because of this experience, we decided not to opt for Medallion Hall (Charni Road), even though we genuinely liked the venue. There are far better and more respectful options available in the market such as Shalimar Restaurant and Persian Darbar etc.
From today onwards, my entire family and I have decided to boycott Delhi Darbar Caterers and their restaurants.
Extremely disappointed. 0 stars.

The culinary experience was outstanding. The menu offered a delightful variety, and the chef’s expertise was evident in the delectable dishes served. Our guests couldn’t stop raving about the quality of the food, and the service staff ensured that everyone’s needs were promptly attended to.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I attended one of my friends wedding here and my friend and their family faced following issues.
1) charged us for speakers even though it was never mentioned before.
2) the speaker and projector they gave didn't work properly, and the staff who was attending it couldn't help us. Didn't have a normal audio jack to connect our laptop to the speakers.
3) changed the menu from what we decided, and refusing to accept they did it on their own.
4) there were broken glass in the venue, which we saw like 2/3 weeks before, and they promised to get it fixed before our function. Which they didn't.
4) refusing to give our deposit back.
5) harassing us by continuously calling us, even though we told them, since you have cameras, share the video with us we'll have a look and see. If it's extra people, we will definitely pay. But they're just telling we need to pay.
6) the original quotation they gave us, and what we finally ended up actually paying, were vastly different.

featured_reviews.review_text:

The team was incredibly professional and accommodating, ensuring every detail was meticulously planned and executed. The staff were attentive, friendly, and always ready to assist with a smile, making the entire event run smoothly.

The food was outstanding, both in quality and quantity. Every dish was flavorful, beautifully presented, and there was more than enough to satisfy all our guests. We received numerous compliments on the meal, which made the day even more special.

The interiors of the banquet hall are stunning, with elegant and tasteful decor that created the perfect ambiance for our celebration. The decor team did an exceptional job, transforming the space into a fairy tale setting that exceeded our expectations.

A special mention goes to Sandeep and Nishita, whose exceptional service truly made our day unforgettable. Sandeep was incredibly attentive to every detail, ensuring that everything ran smoothly and seamlessly. His professionalism and dedication were evident in every interaction. Nishita's creative touch and impeccable taste added a unique flair to our event, making the ambiance truly magical.

Also, Nitin and Mohit were incredibly attentive and responsive, addressing all of our concerns and requests with professionalism and a genuine desire to make our day special.

Overall, MVM provided an unforgettable wedding experience. A big thank you to Sandeep, Nishita, Mohit, and Nitin for their outstanding service and for making the day so special. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: ADITYA SALVI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Just Steps Away from Churchgate Station – Shri Sunderbai Hall

Located barely a **2-minute walk from Churchgate Railway Station**, **Shri Sunderbai Hall** is one of those places you might pass by without noticing, but once you’ve discovered it, you’ll find yourself coming back again and again.

This **spacious and well-maintained hall** has become a go-to venue for a variety of **pop-up exhibitions, sales, and events** that attract crowds from all over Mumbai. Whether it’s a **mega book fair**, a **trendy clothing and handicraft pop-up**, or a **home decor and lifestyle sale**, there’s always something interesting happening here.

One of the standout features of Sunderbai Hall is its **prime location**—literally a stone’s throw away from Churchgate station, making it easily accessible by train, cab, or even on foot if you're already in the Fort/Marine Lines area. The moment you step out of the station, a short walk brings you to this quiet, convenient venue nestled amid the city's hustle.

The hall itself is **quite large and airy**, with enough space to comfortably host multiple stalls without it feeling cramped. Events here are generally **well-organized** with good crowd management, clear signage, and polite staff who ensure everything runs smoothly. There’s always a buzz of activity, but never chaos—an excellent balance!

What’s even better is that most events here are **free to enter** or charge a nominal fee. Perfect for casual browsing or even planned shopping trips, especially if you're into **book bargains, ethnic fashion, artisanal crafts, or curated home goods**.

In a city like Mumbai where space is a premium, **Sunderbai Hall stands out as a reliable and versatile venue** that consistently delivers quality experiences. If you're in the area, keep an eye out—you never know what treasure trove awaits inside.

📍**Location tip:** Exit Churchgate station from the main gate, take a left, and it's right around the corner. Super easy to find!

🗓️**Pro tip:** Check local event listings or posters at the station—there’s always something new happening here!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Islam Gymkhana - 4 Stars 🌟🌟🌟🌟

A historic gem in Mumbai, Islam Gymkhana has stood proudly on Marine Drive since its establishment in 1890, representing more than just sports—it’s a cultural landmark. The lush green lawns outside are nothing short of stunning, offering a serene escape in the heart of the bustling city. 🌳✨

The view? Simply spectacular! Picture this: the expansive sky merging with the Arabian Sea, a golden sunset painting the horizon, the smooth stretch of Marine Drive, and the comforting feel of the grassy lawns underfoot. 🌅🌴 The perfect combination of natural beauty and urban life.

What makes it even more convenient is the location—just steps away from the railway station exit, making it easily accessible for everyone. 🚉 A stroll here feels like stepping into a calm oasis, where the rush of the city meets the soothing sound of the waves. 🌊

Whether you’re here for a game, an event, or just to soak in the peaceful vibes, Islam Gymkhana offers a slice of serenity in the heart of Mumbai’s hustle. Truly a place where history meets beauty!

featured_reviews.name: Ashraf Qureshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Islam Gymkhana is a historic social & sporting club located on Marine Drive.
The land was allotted in 1890, and the club has a large, sea-facing property (around 19,300 sq. m) with both open grounds and built-up areas.
Membership used to be restricted to Muslims but now is open to people of all communities.

featured_reviews.name: ABBAS ALI ARIF
featured_reviews.review_text: Islam Gymkhana came into existence in 1890, Lord Harris, the then Governor allotted the Islam Gymkhana grounds on the Kennedy Sea Face which is popularly known as Marine Drive and now Netaji Subhas Road. They have Resturant servicing food & snacks for guest. It has a big Ground which can be used for playing cricket, walking or football. They have a AC Banquet Hall to host different functions. They have massage, steam & jacuzzi facility for members. Restroom facility available for members & guest. They have a car parking facility for guest. It is located very close to marine lines railway station.

featured_reviews.name: Rupen-Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rotary International had its Rotary-Rotaract Model United Nations for a day on 30th November 25 at the Catholic Gym. 50 countries were represented by Rotary & Rotaract clubs. CG was quite Cooperative in helping us put up flags of various nations and create the UN atmosphere.

The ground floor banquet room is quite spacious and can easily accommodate 200+ people. The air-conditioning was cool, lights & sound system working perfectly and support staff helpful.

The food was quite appropriate with a mix on Indian & continental cuisine.

Parking is a challenge, though we hired a valet for the visitor’s cars.

featured_reviews.name: Ameya Sapre
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great time here with some catholic friends who are members of this place. Booze is cheap and food is damn good. The buff chilli was good and even the garlic bread and the chicken wings. Try out everything from their menu! Service is quick. Washrooms are clean. Definitely visiting again with the boys for a Friday nightout after work!

featured_reviews.review_text: Nice Gymkhana for wedding and other functions. We attended a wedding function recently. The location of the Gym is bang opposite the marine drive promenade stretch near charni road. Valet parking was available.  The ambience was good. The washrooms were clean and we'll maintained. Along with the food and all other elements it turned out to be a good experience.

featured_reviews.name: Rakesh gawde
featured_reviews.review_text: Food is excellent. We went there in hot summert 🌞 Temperature 43🫠. We were ask to wait for 20 min😓. But when food came all the waiting suddenly feel like worth it. 🤤

featured_reviews.name: Ashutosh Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience at Catholic Gymkhana.

The event was poorly managed, and there was absolutely no proper parking arrangement for guests. Many attendees faced unnecessary inconvenience just to find a parking space.

Another major issue is that the venue is located adjacent to a hospital. Even when only soft music was being played, police reportedly arrived due to complaints, disrupting the event and creating an uncomfortable atmosphere for guests. This is a significant limitation that prospective clients should be informed about in advance.

The entrance area was also unpleasant due to a foul smell coming from nearby garbage accumulation, creating a very poor first impression for guests arriving for the function.

What made the experience even worse was the attitude of the staff. The staff members were extremely rude, uncooperative, and irresponsible. They appeared least bothered about the inconvenience caused to guests and showed little interest in resolving issues or providing assistance when needed. Customer service and hospitality standards were far below what one would expect from a reputed venue.

Considering the cost of hosting an event here, the overall experience was highly unsatisfactory. I would not recommend Catholic Gymkhana for weddings, receptions, or other important family functions unless these issues are seriously addressed. ⭐☆☆☆☆

featured_reviews.name: Dominic Savio Braganza
featured_reviews.review_text:
Situated just at the side of Taraporewala Aquarium.

Lots of space for fun, they just had their Christmas Celebrations, really good. Well planned.

Lots of stalls with cool stuff on sale.

Food rates are reasonable and food is really tasty. Portion sizes are good. Lots of good food to choose from.

The place was really well decorated for the Christmas Celebrations.

Santa was amazing and presented gifts to children.

Parking is an issue (especially during functions) here since the access roads are closed for construction work by BMC.
